subject: Greenleaf: dual-portal access request & evidence split plan
messages:
From: Eve Larson <eve@greenleafhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: tom.reynolds@greenleafhealth.com
Date: 2025-11-10T09:15:00Z
Subject: Portal access for vendor assessment (Vendr + Whistic)

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Our procurement team asked us to onboard Redwood into both Vendr (for ticketing/contract metadata) and Whistic (for the questionnaire). Security would like the following scoped items uploaded to the portals by end of next week:

- SOC 2 Type II report (latest)
- Network diagram and data flow (for CAIQ mapping)
- Answers to the CAIQ-style mapping spreadsheet (we can accept a starter mapping)
- Any ancillary policies referenced in the CAIQ (retention, encryption at rest)

We will attach the SOC 2 and network diagram to this thread. We also included a starter spreadsheet (sig_caia_mapping_request.xlsx) that your team can fill in; security wants to see CAIQ mappings where possible.

Primary contacts on our side are me (security) and Tom (procurement). Our timeline is tight: vendor onboarding kickoff on 2025-11-17. Can you confirm who will own each portal and whether Redwood can push large artifacts to a shared Drive link or if we should upload directly to the portals?

Thanks,
Eve Larson
Senior Security Analyst
Greenleaf Health

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf (stub), network_diagram_v2.png (stub), sig_caia_mapping_request.xlsx (stub)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com
To: Eve Larson <eve@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2025-11-10T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Portal access for vendor assessment (Vendr + Whistic)

Hi Eve — thanks for the detailed list and the attachments. Confirming receipt.

Quick plan proposal so we stay within your 11/17 kickoff:
1) Whistic (questionnaire): Marissa will own the Whistic profile and do the CAIQ mapping upload. She'll fill the sheet and flag any answers that require engineering input.
2) Vendr (contract/metadata): Aditya will handle the Vendr onboarding and coordinate API or manual file transfer for larger artifacts.
3) Redwood security (me): I will review retention/encryption statements and provide a short summary doc that maps to Greenleaf's checklist.

A few clarifying items:
- Which of these documents must remain in Greenleaf's portal only (no shared Drive)? We can respect that but need to know before sending credentials.
- For the CAIQ mapping: do you want the full CAIQ CSV or just the subset in the attached starter sheet? Either is fine, but we want to avoid duplicate work.
- Are there any additional attestations (e.g., vendor-hosted logs, KMS proof) you expect uploaded to Archer instead of Whistic/Vendr?

We can meet briefly tomorrow (30m) to align — propose 2025-11-11T15:00Z. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Eve — happy to own Whistic. I will:
- Create Reddit (sic) — (typo corrected: create Whistic) profile and start the questionnaire entries from the starter sheet.
- Populate the CAIQ mapping columns with initial answers and mark any items that need engineering confirmation.
- Upload the SOC 2 and network diagram to Whistic, unless you prefer those only in Vendr.

I attached a short upload_manifest.csv that outlines the filenames we'll push and the preferred destination (Whistic or Vendr). For Vendr API access, Aditya — can you confirm whether we should use a service account or temporary credentials from Greenleaf? If Greenleaf prefers to push artifacts, we will coordinate an SFTP/Drive link.

I can have the Whistic profile ready for internal review by EOD 2025-11-12. If Eve/Tom want a walkthrough before the 11/17 kickoff we can schedule it.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Ops — Security Enablement
Redwood Inference

- For CAIQ mapping: please fill the starter sheet we attached; our security team will do a QA pass. No need to submit the full CAIQ CSV unless you have a mapped export already.
- Vendr: I can create a temporary API key for you (valid 7 days) if you prefer pull-style ingestion. I am pasting the creds below (please rotate after ingestion).

Thanks everyone — quick summary and owners so we have a single source of truth before the kickoff: 

Action owners: 
- Whistic questionnaire & CAIQ starter sheet: marissa_cole (target: internal review 2025-11-12 EOD; external share 2025-11-13)
- Vendr artifact ingestion (SOC2 canonical + network diagram): aditya_rao (use Eve's temporary API key; target: 2025-11-13)
- Compliance summary mapping (retention, encryption, KMS): rishi_malhotra (short PDF mapping to Greenleaf checklist; target: 2025-11-14)

Eve — we will upload to Vendr as canonical and put a contextual copy in Whistic. Aditya — once ingestion is complete, please reply-all with the Vendr artifact IDs. Marissa — please flag any CAIQ entries that require engineering evidence (I will triage).

I'll set up a brief 20-minute sync on 2025-11-14T16:00Z to confirm everything ahead of the 11/17 kickoff. If anything slips, notify the thread ASAP so Eve/Tom can adjust.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround on your side, Eve.

—Rishi
